cameraChain.note: Main render camera, structurally: CameraManager instance +0x10 (_CameraObjects, fixed array) +0x20 ([0] GameObject) +0x18 (Transform). Transform+0x80 = worldTransform 4x4 (rows right/up/fwd, row3 = CELL-LOCAL pos - use the global camera chain for position). Transform+0x18 (childComponent) = RECamera: near +0x30, far +0x34, fov +0x38, lookAtDistance +0x3c, aspect +0x44. Layouts from REFramework ReClass_Internal_DD2.hpp (MIT).

neverGenerateChain.note: app.GenerateManager._NeverGenetateID: every collectible GUID (tokens AND beetles/chests/etc — not tokens-only) the game will never spawn again. GenerateManager instance +0x10+0x1f0 = the field's live pointer, a HashSet`1<System.Guid> whose own field layout is a verbatim match for real .NET's HashSet<T> (found live via tools/singletonHunt.js --deref). HashSet +0x10+0x08 = _slots array ptr, +0x10+0x20 = _count (i32). _slots array object +0x20 = Slot[0]; each Slot is 16 bytes {hashCode:i32 @0, next:i32 @4, valuePtr:i64 @8} — valuePtr is a BOXED Guid (the VM boxes generic value-type args), so valuePtr+0x10 is the 16 raw Guid bytes, decoded with .NET's own byte order (Data1/2/3 little-endian, Data4 raw). See src/main/generateManagerReader.js.
